part.label: D-Shaft With Intersect Flat
part.description: A round shaft trimmed with an 'intersect' component to a D-profile flat, the classic anti-rotation shape for a shaft that must key into a mating hub.

components.description: Trims the shaft down to just the overlap with this box, leaving a flat on one side (a D-profile) instead of the full round cross-section. Sized taller and wider than the shaft so only the flat position (the box's near Y face) actually clips the round profile.
